## Context Refresh

Before executing any task in this prompt, read the following files in order.
Do not proceed until you can report the summary at the end of this section.

1. `tauira-schema.json` — master schema (source of truth)
2. `config.yaml` — Amethyst site config (note: YAML, not TOML)
3. `data/graphConfig.yaml` — Amethyst force-graph display settings
4. `assets/indices/` — hugo-obsidian link index (do not edit by hand)
5. `static/graph/tauira-graph.json` — compiled Tauira knowledge graph
6. `data/nodes/` — all participant node files
7. `data/edges/` — all relational edge files
8. `content/encounters/` — encounter front matter (skip body text)
9. `content/memos/` — memo front matter
10. `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — baseline Tauira agent rules

Report before proceeding:
- Total node count and MKI breakdown
- Total edge count and most-used relationshipType
- Total encounter count and date range
- Which RQ has the fewest non-empty `rqAlignment` annotations
- Whether `assets/indices/` is up to date compared with newest content file

## Amethyst Architecture Reference

Keep these conventions in mind for every task in this prompt.

### Theme-specific file locations

| Purpose | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Site config | `config.yaml` | Use YAML, not TOML |
| Graph display config | `data/graphConfig.yaml` | Controls Amethyst's built-in graph |
| Link index | `assets/indices/` | Auto-generated by `hugo-obsidian`; never edit manually |
| SCSS overrides | `assets/_custom.scss` | Place custom style imports here |
| Variable overrides | `assets/_variables.scss` | Theme variables override |
| Color scheme | `assets/_colors.scss` | Palette override |
| Font override | `assets/_fonts.scss` | Font loading and replacement |
| Favicon | `static/favicon.png` | Replace Amethyst default |
| Inject partial: head | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/head.html` | Safe place for CSS/JS/head tags |
| Inject partial: body | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/body.html` | Safe place for scripts before `</body>` |
| Inject partial: menu-before | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/menu-before.html` | Add branding or controls above nav |
| Inject partial: menu-after | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/menu-after.html` | Add filters below nav |
| Inject partial: content-before | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/content-before.html` | Add node badges or context block |
| Inject partial: content-after | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/content-after.html` | Add assemblages, related encounters |
| Inject partial: toc-before | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/toc-before.html` | Add RQ summary above ToC |
| Inject partial: toc-after | `layouts/partials/docs/inject/toc-after.html` | Add memo or graph links below ToC |

### Theme front matter keys used by Amethyst

Every content file may use these keys in addition to Tauira schema params:

```yaml
type: docs
weight: 10
bookFlatSection: false
bookCollapseSection: true
bookHidden: false
bookToC: true
bookSearchExclude: false
```

Use them as follows:
- `type: docs` for all Tauira content rendered through Amethyst
- `weight` to control sidebar ordering
- `bookHidden: true` for draft/private encounters
- `bookToC: false` on map pages and short memo pages
- `bookSearchExclude: true` only for technical or generated helper pages

### Important graph distinction

There are **two separate graphs** in this site:

1. **Amethyst force-graph** — based on wikilinks and generated into `assets/indices/` by `hugo-obsidian`
2. **Tauira rhizomatic graph** — based on your schema (`nodes`, `edges`, `encounters`) and exported to `static/graph/tauira-graph.json`

Do not confuse these systems.
Do not write custom Tauira graph data into `assets/indices/`.
Do not manually edit `assets/indices/`.

---

## Part 1 — Graph Health Audit

Run all checks and report findings as a markdown table before suggesting fixes.

### 1.1 Orphan Detection

- **Orphan nodes**: nodes in `data/nodes/` with zero `encounterRefs`
- **Orphan edges**: edges in `data/edges/` whose `source` or `target` does not match an existing node `id`
- **Dangling refs**: encounters whose `nodeRefs`, `edgeRefs`, `memoRef`, or `artefactRefs` point to missing files
- **Broken wikilinks**: any `[[wikilink]]` in `content/**/*.md` that does not resolve to an existing file

For broken wikilinks, list:
- source file
- line number if available
- unresolved wikilink text

Do not auto-fix any of the above. Report only.

### 1.2 RQ Coverage Analysis

For each research question (`RQ1`, `RQ1a`, `RQ1b`):
- Count encounters with non-empty alignment
- Identify 3 encounters with strongest annotations
- Identify 3 with weakest annotations
- Recommend which weak encounters are most worth revisiting

### 1.3 MKI Balance Check

Count nodes by category:
- M = Material
- K = Knowledge
- I = Instinctual

If one category exceeds 60% of all nodes, flag this as a likely conceptual blind spot.
Suggest 2–3 plausible undernamed participant types from the underrepresented categories.

### 1.4 Edge Density Report

For each `relationshipType`:
- count edges
- identify types with zero edges
- identify top 3 highest-weight node pairs

Interpret zero-count relationship types as underdeveloped analytical categories.

### 1.5 Temporal Coverage

Sort encounters by date and report:
- gaps > 3 weeks
- dense weeks/terms with > 3 encounters
- vignette completion rate
- list of encounters missing `fieldnote.vignette` if completion is below 80%

### 1.6 Search Index Coverage

Check whether encounters, essays, and memos are unintentionally excluded from search by:
```yaml
bookSearchExclude: true
```

List all such pages for review.

### 1.7 Sidebar Weight Audit

Because Amethyst uses `weight` for navigation order:
- verify every encounter has a `weight`
- verify no duplicate weights within a section
- recommend a stable weight strategy

Recommended default:
- encounter `weight = YYYYMMDD` integer based on date

## Part 2 — Amethyst Wiring Tasks

Use Amethyst's inject partials instead of modifying the theme directly.

### 2.1 Node Badge Strip

Create or update:
`layouts/partials/docs/inject/content-before.html`

Render a responsive row of node badges for encounter and essay pages.

Rules:
- read `.Params.nodeRefs`
- resolve IDs via `.Site.Data.nodes`
- colour by MKI:
  - M = `#01696f`
  - K = `#5b4fcf`
  - I = `#d19900`
- skip memos
- wrap on mobile, single row when possible on desktop

### 2.2 RQ Alignment Panel

Create or update:
`layouts/partials/docs/inject/toc-before.html`

Show a compact panel above the ToC for encounters and essays:
- render only non-empty RQ entries
- style as subtle cards, not a table
- label each section clearly: `RQ1`, `RQ1a`, `RQ1b`

### 2.3 Assemblage and Related Content Panel

Create or update:
`layouts/partials/docs/inject/content-after.html`

Render:
1. Assemblage tags from `.Params.assemblages`
2. Links to related encounters sharing one or more assemblages
3. Link to the encounter's memo if `.Params.memoRef` exists

Use Hugo taxonomies where possible.

### 2.4 Rhizomatic Map Page

Create:
`content/map/_index.md`

```yaml
---
title: "Rhizomatic Map"
type: docs
weight: 1
bookToC: false
bookSearchExclude: true
---
```

Create or update:
`layouts/partials/docs/inject/body.html`

Inject sigma.js or D3 only on map pages.
Use the deployed subpath-aware graph URL:

```js
fetch('/tauira/graph/tauira-graph.json')
```

Do not use `/graph/tauira-graph.json` without the `/tauira/` prefix because the site is deployed at a project path, not the root domain.

### 2.5 graphConfig.yaml Alignment

Update `data/graphConfig.yaml` to document and tune the **Amethyst** graph.

Add a comment at the top explaining:
- Amethyst graph = wikilink graph
- Tauira rhizomatic map = schema graph
- MKI colours apply only to the custom Tauira map

Retain Amethyst-compatible fields such as:

```yaml
enableLegend: true
enableDrag: true
depth: 1
enableRadial: false
repelForce: 0.5
centerForce: 0.3
linkDistance: 50
fontSize: 12
opacityScale: 3
```

## Part 3 — Schema Evolution

Do not apply changes without explicit confirmation.

### 3.1 Candidate New Fields

Evaluate whether the following should be added:

```yaml
# encounter
termRef: string
weekRef: string
lessonPhase: string
weight: integer

# node
firstEncounterRef: string
frequency: integer

# edge
firstObserved: string
lastObserved: string
trajectory: string

# analyticMemo
theoreticalFrameworks:
  type: array
  items: { type: string }
```

For each:
- Is it backfillable from current data?
- Does it require schema update?
- Does it require Hugo template updates?
- Does it require Amethyst inject partial changes?

### 3.2 Schema Versioning Protocol

When approved:
1. bump `$id` from v1 to v2
2. add `schemaVersion` to root object
3. create `scripts/migrate-v1-to-v2.js`
4. validate with `ajv`
5. write migration log
6. archive old files to `data/_archive/v1/`

### 3.3 Multi-Researcher Scaling

If Tauira expands to multiple contributors:
- add `researcherId` to encounters, nodes, edges
- add `visibility: private | peer | public`
- map `visibility` to Amethyst display controls like `bookHidden`
- introduce `data/controlled-vocabulary/` for shared canonical nodes

## Part 4 — Graph Cartography Tasks

### 4.1 Regenerate Full Graph Export

Build `static/graph/tauira-graph.json` from `data/nodes/` and `data/edges/`.

Use this structure:

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": "<ISO timestamp>",
    "nodeCount": 0,
    "edgeCount": 0,
    "schemaVersion": "v1",
    "baseURL": "/tauira/",
    "categories": { "M": 0, "K": 0, "I": 0 }
  },
  "nodes": [],
  "edges": []
}
```

Validate all edge references before writing.

### 4.2 Term-Level Map Snapshots

For each term:
- collect nodes and edges referenced in term encounters
- create `data/maps/map-<term>.json`
- set `renderEngine: "sigma.js"`
- create matching content page under `content/map/`

### 4.3 Assemblage Extraction

Generate `data/assemblages-report.json` by deduplicating all encounter assemblages.

For each assemblage:
- count encounters
- identify core nodes
- write a 2–3 sentence characterisation

---

## Part 5 — GPT Fine-Tuning Preparation

### 5.1 Generate Training Pairs

Create prompt-completion pairs from encounters + memos.
Write to:
`scripts/fine-tuning/training-data.jsonl`

Use format:

```jsonl
{"prompt":"Scene: ...\nAgency: ...\nCare: ...\nVignette: ...\n\nWrite an analytic memo addressing RQ1a:","completion":"..."}
```

Report:
- number of pairs
- average completion length
- memos under 100 words

### 5.2 Embedding-Ready Chunking

Write:
`scripts/fine-tuning/rag-chunks.jsonl`

Each chunk must include:
- `encounterId`
- `chunkType`
- `nodeRefs`
- `assemblages`
- `date`
- `baseURL`
- `text`

Use `baseURL: "/tauira/"` so runtime systems can construct valid links in the deployed project-site environment.

### 5.3 Gap Analysis Corpus

Collect all accepted gap suggestions into:
`scripts/fine-tuning/accepted-gaps.json`

This becomes a validated diffractive corpus for few-shot prompting.

---

## Part 6 — Publication & Examination Readiness

### 6.1 Thesis Chapter Mapping

Create:
`docs/thesis-encounter-map.md`

Table format:

```markdown
| Encounter ID | Date | RQ1 | RQ1a | RQ1b | Assemblages | Key nodes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
```

Flag encounters spanning all three RQs as likely thesis key scenes.

### 6.2 Examiner Tours

Generate 3 examiner-oriented `rqTour` files:
- `data/tours/tour-examiner-rq1.json`
- `data/tours/tour-examiner-rq1a.json`
- `data/tours/tour-examiner-rq1b.json`

Each should:
- begin with a clear exemplar encounter
- include a theorising essay
- include one rhizomatic map
- end with a memo showing accepted diffractive suggestions

Also create corresponding content stubs if you want them visible in the Amethyst sidebar.

### 6.3 Anonymisation Audit

Scan all content and data for:
- probable personal names
- `artefact` items missing `anonymised: true`
- direct student quotations
- public pages containing sensitive material

Do not auto-redact. Report only.

### 6.4 Pre-Publication Checklist

Before tagging a release, verify:

- `config.yaml` baseURL is `https://bibymaths.github.io/tauira/`
- workflow has no `cname`
- `static/graph/tauira-graph.json` is fresh
- `assets/indices/` is fresh
- custom graph fetch paths use `/tauira/graph/tauira-graph.json`
- `data/graphConfig.yaml` includes graph distinction note
- no broken wikilinks
- all encounter weights are set
- private pages use `bookHidden: true`
- favicon is no longer Amethyst default
